objective: Make the Northflank container actually start the already-promoted Quest v2 runtime and make CI fail if the deployed Docker or PostgreSQL HTTP entrypoint reports an older model version.

roles_before.artifact: Northflank System Core is sourced from Misterrenok/ron-os main and deployed build understood-cast-549 at commit 401007c35851445e189409a8e43760cadbef8832.
The Dockerfile still executes src/server.mjs even though package.json and the promoted Quest v2 runtime target src/server-v2.mjs.
Store initialization in the selected runtime owns ordered schema/migration application; production still lacks migrations 005 and 006 because the old runtime was started.
Production player ledger contains 6 events and 0 Quest v2 events; deployment must not create player events.
Quest v1 and calibration behavior remain backward-compatible inside server-v2/store-v2 and migrations 002-004 remain preserved.
Docker smoke currently accepts model_version calibration-v1, so it cannot detect the stale production entrypoint.
HTTP-through-PostgreSQL smoke currently starts src/server.mjs and asserts calibration-v1, so it does not verify the promoted Quest v2 server path.
Legacy src/server.mjs, src/store.mjs and migrations 002-004 remain preserved as compatibility/rollback evidence rather than the production entrypoint.

role_dispositions.destination: Ron explicitly authorized the bounded fix promotion on 2026-09-11: promoted manifest -> CI -> non-force main fast-forward -> Northflank automatic latest-main deploy -> production migrations 005/006 -> read-only runtime/schema/ledger verification, without Quest v2 player events.
system/lifeup/cloud/Dockerfile CMD executes src/server-v2.mjs, matching package.json and the promoted runtime.
server-v2/store-v2 continues applying schema plus migrations 002-006 in order; a later separately authorized redeploy may apply 005/006.
Candidate code and CI use isolated ephemeral/PostgreSQL test stores only; production remains read-only at 6 total / 0 Quest v2 events.
Existing v1 model, calibration policy and migrations remain present and covered by the full test suite.
Docker smoke requires model_version quest-v2 so a stale CMD fails deterministically.
PostgreSQL HTTP smoke starts server-v2 and requires quest-v2 health/snapshot while retaining existing profile/idempotency checks.
Legacy v1 runtime files and Git history remain available; only the production container entrypoint changes.

capability_probes.assertion: The built production Docker image returns HTTP 200 with model_version quest-v2 and retains authenticated snapshot/UI behavior.
Changing Docker CMD back to src/server.mjs makes Docker smoke fail on the model_version assertion.
Profile calibration, idempotency, reward evidence, PWA availability and the append-only ledger regression suite still pass.
Legacy server/store files and migrations 002-004 remain unchanged and recoverable; Git history retains the failed deployed configuration.

tests.expected: PASS only when the Dockerfile starts server-v2 and /healthz reports model_version quest-v2.
PASS only when server-v2 runs through PostgreSQL, migrations 005/006 load, and health/snapshot report quest-v2.

tests.expected: PASS for Quest v2, calibration, v1 compatibility, profile, projection, idempotency and database constraints.
PASS with no owner/routing loss and legacy LifeUp rollback path preserved.
